# 增補鄭氏周易

**ID:** KR1a0004
**Custom ID:** ZB1a0003
**Date (file):** 2015-08-24 21:53:17.028389
**Source:** 四庫全書 文淵閣版, V7.3, p147
**Extent:** 3 卷
**Base edition:** WYG

## Authors / Editors
- 鄭玄 (漢朝) 撰 127 - 200
- 王應麟 (宋朝) 輯
- 惠棟 (清朝) 考補

**Editions:** WYG

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A Qīng *kǎozhèng* 考證 augmentation, in three *juàn*, of [王應麟](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%8B%E6%87%89%E9%BA%9F) Wáng Yīnglín's late-Sòng one-*juàn* reconstruction of [鄭玄](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%84%AD%E7%8E%84) Zhèng Xuán's lost *Zhōuyì zhù* 周易註 (= [KR1a0003](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1a/KR1a0003)). Where Wáng had assembled the surviving fragments without consistent source-citation and not always in canonical sequence, [惠棟](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%83%A0%E6%A3%9F) Huì Dòng of Chángzhōu 長洲 (Sūzhōu) traced each Wáng-recorded passage back to its specific source text, reordered everything to follow the received *Zhōuyì*, and combed further sources to add 92 new fragments — 28 for the upper canon, 16 for the lower canon, 14 for the *Xìcí zhuàn* 繫辭傳, 22 for the *Shuōguà zhuàn* 說卦傳, 7 for the *Xùguà zhuàn* 序卦傳, and 5 for the *Záguà zhuàn* 雜卦傳. He moved Wáng's prefatory *Zhèng shì Zhōuyì zàn* 鄭氏周易贊 to the head of the work, deleted the eight illustrative *hùtǐ* 互體 citations Wáng had appended, and added at the end two diagrams reconstructed from Zhèng's lost commentaries on the *Zhōulǐ Tàishī* 周禮太師 (a twelve-month *yáochén* 爻辰 chart) and the *Yuè lìng* 月令 (a *yáochén*-and-twenty-eight-mansions chart). The added diagrams are aimed explicitly against [朱震](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9C%B1%E9%9C%87) Zhū Zhèn's *Hànshàng Yìzhuàn* 漢上易傳 ([KR1a0024](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1a/KR1a0024)).

This is the canonical Qīng-evidential reconstruction of Hàn-Yì Zhèng *Yì*; it is the form in which Zhèng Xuán's *Yì* fragments are normally cited in modern scholarship. The WYG *tiyao* and the Kanripo source file `KR1a0004_000.txt` print the work under the Sìkù-imposed title *Xīnběn Zhèng shì Zhōuyì* 新本鄭氏周易 ("New Edition Zhèng-Family Zhōuyì"); the Kanripo catalog and most secondary literature use Huì Dòng's own title *Zēngbǔ Zhèng shì Zhōuyì* 增補鄭氏周易 ("Augmented..."). The dating window 1730–1758 reflects the assumed mature-period composition span of Huì Dòng's reconstruction. The catalog dynasty field is 漢 by the Sìkù convention recorded in the *tiyao* of [KR1a0003](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1a/KR1a0003) (recompiled lost works are filed under the original author's dynasty).

**Abstract**

[惠棟](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%83%A0%E6%A3%9F) Huì Dòng (1697–1758), of Yuánhé 元和 / Chángzhōu 長洲 (Sūzhōu), the founding figure of the Wú-school 吳派 of Qīng *Hàn xué* 漢學 and the most rigorous of the early evidentialists on the *Yì*. The recompilation here was part of his programmatic project to recover the Hàn *Yì* ([孟喜](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AD%9F%E5%96%9C) Mèng Xǐ, [京房](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%BA%AC%E6%88%BF) Jīng Fáng, [虞翻](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%99%9E%E7%BF%BB) Yú Fān, [鄭玄](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%84%AD%E7%8E%84) Zhèng Xuán) against the Wáng Bì–Chéng Yí–Zhū Xī line that had dominated since the Northern Sòng. His other principal *Yì* monographs are *Zhōuyì shù* 周易述 (= [KR1a0105](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1a/KR1a0105)) and *Yì Hàn xué* 易漢學 (= [KR1a0106](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1a/KR1a0106)), with related material in *Yì lì* 易例 (= [KR1a0107](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1a/KR1a0107)) — all of them pendants to the present source-collection.

The text-critical method is exact: every Wáng-Yīnglín fragment is verified back against its source (notably [李鼎祚](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9D%8E%E9%BC%8E%E7%A5%9A) Lǐ Dǐngzuò's *Zhōuyì jíjiě* [KR1a0008](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1a/KR1a0008), [陸德明](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%99%B8%E5%BE%B7%E6%98%8E) Lù Démíng's *Jīngdiǎn shìwén*, the *zhèngyì* of *Shī*, *Sānlǐ*, *Chūnqiū*, and the *Hòu Hànshū* and *Wénxuǎn* commentaries), and the source is cited inline — a methodological standard not seen in Yīnglín's original. Huì Dòng's 92 newly added fragments are mostly drawn from Sòng *lèishū* 類書 and from the early Qīng's improving access to *Hòu Hànshū* and *Sānlǐ* sub-commentaries. The two appended *yáochén* diagrams are reconstructions from extant fragments of Zhèng's lost *Sānlǐ* sub-commentaries: they reify Zhèng's correlative-cosmological method in graphic form and are the basis on which Huì Dòng adjudicates the Hàn-versus-Sòng dispute over Hàn *Yì* diagrams (esp. against Zhū Zhèn's reduction of *yáochén* to a Hé-Luò 河洛 numerology).

The work was complete by Huì Dòng's death in 1758, well before the Sìkù 四庫 commission was constituted (1772). The *Sìkù* *tiyao* retitled it *Xīnběn Zhèng shì Zhōuyì* (the title it bears in the WYG print) in order to distinguish it editorially from Wáng Yīnglín's original "old edition"; secondary literature follows Huì Dòng's own title *Zēngbǔ Zhèng shì Zhōuyì*. The two are the same work.
